newsitem.title: FINLAND: Analysts on UPM, M-Serla deal.
newsitem.headline: Analysts on UPM, M-Serla deal.

text.p: Following are analysts' initial comments on Tuesday to a string of asset deals announced by Finnish forestry groups UPM-Kymmene Oy and Metsa-Serla Oy :
"The transaction looks sensible from UPM-Kymmene's perspective."
"It represents a step in the direction of increased focus and streamlining, which is the right direction for the pulp and paper industry and it will also improve the balance sheet."
"I estimate the impact on UPM-Kymmene's equity would be (an increase) in the order of 200-300 million markka."
"Boards are not a significant sector for UPM -- for Metsa-Serla this strengthens its position in niche-products."
"The positive thing is that Metsa-Serla's balance sheet will remain strong as it finances the deal partly with the proceeds of the sale of its chemicals businesses."
"It will not have a huge effect in the near-term, but the result forecasts for next year will nonetheless have to be revised."
